_comment: The allow-list data (#1314, #1347). Content is #1297's ruling, recorded verbatim on #1314's closing comment: one tree, one manifest, harness dialect carried in frontmatter by KEY NAME — so this is one allow-list per artefact kind (agents, skills, commands), admitting both harnesses' documented keys and requiring one of each harness's required keys, never two per-harness lists. Both directions are enforced by frontmatter-check.mjs: unknown keys are rejected, required keys are enforced, and a third class this ticket's contract did not originally anticipate — `forbidden` — catches a key that IS documented on a harness but silently re-routes a member's tier, tree, or dispatch. Sources: Claude sub-agents/skills docs (2.1.265), omp://task-agent-discovery.md, omp://skills.md, omp://slash-command-internals.md; measurements from #1293, #1297, #1298, #1302, #1303, #1315.

forbidden.thinking: omp alias of thinking-level — one spelling only
forbidden.prewalk: omp: silent mid-run model hand-off — the tier degradation the map forbids
forbidden.advisor: omp: silent mid-run model hand-off — the tier degradation the map forbids
forbidden.isolation: Claude worktree isolation — #1315 rules members never use harness isolation
forbidden.permissionMode: Claude: documented as ignored for plugin subagents — a key that reads as configuration and does nothing is a silent drop by definition
forbidden.mcpServers: Claude: documented as ignored for plugin subagents — a key that reads as configuration and does nothing is a silent drop by definition
forbidden.hooks: Claude: documented as ignored for plugin subagents — a key that reads as configuration and does nothing is a silent drop by definition
forbidden.experimental: Claude-only prompt-cache tuning (experimental.cacheTtl) — no omp analogue, orthogonal to the tier/dialect keys this list polices
forbidden.initialPrompt: Claude-only: takes effect only when the agent runs as the main session agent (--agent/agent setting), never for a dispatched subagent — silently inert for a fleet member

name.message: must be fleet--prefixed with no ':' — Claude refuses to load a name containing ':' and omp's registry is bare-name/unnamespaced, so the prefix is the only collision guard (#1303)

forbidden.model: Claude-only per-skill tier override — silent on omp; tier lives in agent definitions only
forbidden.effort: Claude-only per-skill tier override — silent on omp; tier lives in agent definitions only
forbidden.context: Claude fork-mode — a member spawned by a skill bypasses the fleet's dispatch rules
